persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w:
Can you make one audio-only clip, around 8 seconds, with two clearly different voices? Friendly, natural conversation. A is a lower voice, B is a higher voice. Read only the lines, not the labels:
A: Ready to go?
B: Almost. Have you got the tickets?
A: Right here.
B: Great, let's go!
No music or sound effects.
bank.Exact dialogue and order: A: Ready to go? B: Almost. Have you got the tickets? A: Right here. B: Great, let's go!
bank.Speaker assignment: A has a lower voice and reads lines one and three; B has a higher voice and reads lines two and four.
bank.Performance: Friendly, natural conversation with clearly distinguishable voices.
bank.Labels and background audio: Do not read the speaker labels. No music or sound effects.
bank.Delivery format: One combined playable audio file, not separate files for each voice and not a video; audio file format is your call.

messages.text: Could you make a clip with two clearly different voices having a friendly, natural conversation? I have a little exchange in mind that reminds me of getting ready to head out with a friend. What I want is one audio-only clip, around 8 seconds, with A as the lower voice and B as the higher voice. Please read only these lines in this order, not the labels: A: “Ready to go?” B: “Almost. Have you got the tickets?” A: “Right here.” B: “Great, let's go!” I always find these tiny everyday conversations surprisingly charming. Please don't include any music or sound effects.
